recipes.title: Salted Caramel "Twix" Bars

items.i: PB2 (powdered peanut butter), mixed with water

steps: Mix the almond flour, melted coconut oil, maple syrup and vanilla. Press firmly into a lined glass dish and freeze 10 minutes.
Mix the PB2 paste and cashew butter, then add the maple syrup, melted coconut oil and salt and stir until smooth.
Spread the caramel evenly over the base and freeze 1 hour.
Melt the chocolate and dip or pour it over each bar until coated.
Sprinkle with flaky salt and refrigerate 30 minutes to set.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros per bar come from the video description (the creator's lighter version, using PB2 with the cashew butter). Active time only; add about 1½ hours of freezing and chilling.
